group_manifest.proof_strategy: Unfold the witness, introduce linklist_pre, and instantiate nodes_general with nil. Use the allowed route `rewrite <- sepcon_emp_equiv at 1`; `cancel (xizi_dll linklist_pre nil)`; `apply_sepcon_adjoint`; `Intros retval_2`; `Intros`; `Exists 0`; `simpl in *`; `entailer!`. This preserves the input DLL in the outer sepcon and uses the wand antecedent's DLL for the weak post. Explicitly do not use derivable1_sepcon_mono or derivable1_refl; also avoid elim_wand_emp_emp, derivable1_trans, forbidden sepcon equivalence lemmas, and every other name in forbidden_lemma.md.
